title: Senior Salesforce Functional Lead
summary: Senior functional lead for a Salesforce delivery team. Own business-process design, requirements, and configuration decisions, and guide the build toward outcomes the business signs off on. Based in Toronto and open to candidates authorized to work in Canada.
responsibilities: Lead discovery with business stakeholders and translate their processes into Salesforce solution designs.
Own functional requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria through build, test, and release.
Guide configuration decisions across flows, objects, and permissions, and review work for fit and quality.
Run workshops, demos, and UAT cycles with business users and confirm functional readiness.
requirements: Senior-level experience leading functional delivery on Salesforce programs.
Strong command of Salesforce platform capabilities and configuration trade-offs.
Clear written and verbal communication with business and technical stakeholders.
niceToHave: Salesforce certifications, for example Administrator or a Sales/Service Cloud Consultant track.
Consulting or other client-facing delivery experience.
